message: bridge-deduction-a (DRAFT outline): fixture A careful run, favour first, on test_social_deduction_a. Steps A0-A8 of DEDUCTION_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md §9.2. Minigames the harness cannot solve (lockpicking, dusting, the log filter) are driven by the T packet; here each is a note plus a wait on the global it sets.

fn:
async () => { /* A0 board baseline: title, three profile cards, twelve count lines all '0 found', five suspect cards with every cell Hidden, the costly stakes line with the score suffix and briefText, no Make the call */ const d = window.__ded.board(); const mg = window.MinigameFramework.currentMinigame; const txt = mg.container.textContent;
  return !!d && d.view === 'board' && d.title === 'Open evening' && d.profiles.join() === 'keyholder,courier,devotee'
    && Object.keys(d.counts).length === 12 && Object.values(d.counts).every(c => c.found === 0)
    && d.suspects.length === 5 && d.suspects.every(s => s.cells.every(c => c.state === 'hidden') && s.mark === 'undecided' && !s.verdict)
    && /a wrong call will change what you can do next/i.test(d.stakesLine) && /costs part of your score/.test(d.stakesLine)
    && /Name an innocent guest/.test(d.briefText) && d.canSubmit === false && !/Make the call/.test(txt)
    && /Brass Tesseract key: 1 in this case, 0 found/.test(txt) && /✦ marked/.test(txt); }

async () => { /* A0 Tab order: every mark button and Close is reachable by Tab, in card order */ const mg = window.MinigameFramework.currentMinigame; const f = [...mg.container.querySelectorAll('button, [tabindex="0"]')].filter(e => !e.disabled);
  return f.length >= 16 && f.some(e => /Close/.test(e.textContent)) && f.filter(e => e.getAttribute('aria-pressed') !== null).length === 15; }

async () => { /* A0 Esc closes the board as a normal exit, no minigame_failed */ const t = window.__test; await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300)); const l = t.peekLog(200); let i = -1; l.forEach((e, j) => { if (e.kind === 'note' && e.message === 'A0 escape') i = j; });
  const evs = l.slice(i + 1).filter(e => e.kind === 'event'); return !t.getState().activeMinigame && !evs.some(e => e.event === 'minigame_failed'); }

async () => { /* leave HaX */ const ok = await window.__ded.pick("^That's all for now"); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 600)); if (window.MinigameFramework.currentMinigame) await window.__test.minigame.close(); return ok; }

  return r.state.nudged.length === 0 && Object.values(r.decidable).every(v => v === false) && window.__ded.toastsMatching('You have enough to decide').length === 0; }

async () => { /* A4 the only new nudge is Delacroix (the badge log clears her on the pass); every suspect now decidable */ const r = window.__ded.rt(); const n = window.__ded.toastsMatching('You have enough to decide').map(a => String(a[0]));
  return n.filter(x => /Delacroix/.test(x)).length === 1 && n.length === 5 && Object.values(r.decidable).every(Boolean); }

async () => { /* A6 Not yet keeps the case open */ if (!(await window.__ded.call('HaX'))) return false; if (!(await window.__ded.pick('^I.m ready to go into the sanctum'))) return false; if (!(await window.__ded.pick('^Not yet'))) return false;
  await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 400)); return window.__ded.g().deduction_closed === false; }
async () => { /* A7 cancel is the 'not yet': nothing ends */ await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 400)); return window.__ded.g().a_ending === false; }

async () => { /* A8 reload after the end: the visualiser reopens with the neutral header */ const end = Date.now() + 20000; while (Date.now() < end && !(window.BondVisualiser && window.BondVisualiser.isOpen())) await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250));
  const txt = (document.querySelector('.bond-visualiser') || document.body).textContent; return /CASE CLOSED/.test(txt) && !/MISSION COMPLETE/.test(txt); }
